description: Add a person to the Gigaverse IRA waitlist. This does NOT open a PRActicle Roth IRA or any other account and does NOT email the user. Those IRA products are waitlist-only and are not open to consumers. The response says the person was added to the waitlist. Agents cannot open an account. partner_id is required and must already be an approved partner. Approval is in Mission Control (https://mc.trydragonfly.com). Idempotent per email.

partner_id.description: Approved partner attribution slug (from register_partner, after approval)

sandbox.description: true = test mode: nothing is stored, no email is sent, and the response says the person was added to the waitlist. No account is opened.

name: start_signup
